content: iOS Safari requires AudioContext.resume() to be called synchronously inside a user-gesture handler (touchend/click), with no await before it, to unlock audio for the session; a single shared AudioContext instance should be reused thereafter (Safari caps open AudioContext instances at 4). Device physical mute switch silences Web Audio output regardless of code. Sources: MDN Web Audio best practices, Matt Montag unlock write-up, WebKit bug 180522, Chromium blink-dev thread.
